Lv. 1 unlock: Active skills apply <color=#FE3116>Lightning Charge</color> to enemies. When an active skill hits a <color=#FE3116>Lightning Charge</color> target, Enel <color=#FE3116>conducts</color> Thunder DMG equal to <color=#FE3116>9%</color> of his ATK once to all targets with <color=#FE3116>Lightning Charge</color>. Each skill can <color=#FE3116>conduct</color> up to <color=#FE3116>3</color> times (conduction DMG only applies on the first skill attack each turn). Recovers <color=#FE3116>30</color> Rage when casting <color=#FE3116>Thunder Bird</color>.
<color=#999999>Lv. 2 unlock: All DMG reduction +20%.

Lv. 5 unlock: In Thunder God state, conduction is fixed at 6 times; active skills deal 6 instances of conduction DMG to targets with Lightning Charge, and for each fewer target within the skill's range, the conduction DMG multiplier increases by 3%.</color>

rows.skillDesc: Each　skill　attack　adds　one　Chill　stack　to　all　enemies.　If　a　target　reaches　3　Chill　stacks,　clear　all　Chill,　apply　Extreme　Cold　and　Enhanced　Freeze;　consume　Chill.\nExtreme　Cold:　Lower　All　Damage　Bonus　and　All　Damage　Reduction　by　{buffper1,57714}%　for　3　turns;　up　to　2　stacks.　An　Extreme　Cold　target　gets　Enhanced　Freeze　after　acting.　Hits　on　an　Enhanced　Freeze　target　always　crit;　their　attacks　cannot　be　interrupted.　Enhanced　Freeze　is　control　that　ignores　immunity　and　enemy-effect　cleanses,　but　control　cleanses　can　remove　it;　it　lasts　until　the　next　action.\nYamato　is　immune.

Each　Block　has　a　<color=#d14e0d>{buffodds}%</color>　chance　to　gain　<color=#d14e0d>Parry</color>.　At　turn　start,　consume　all　<color=#d14e0d>Parry</color>　stacks　for　these　effects:
Above　1　Parry　stack,　each　<color=#d14e0d>1</color>　<color=#d14e0d>Parry</color>　stack　raises　current　Speed　by　<color=#d14e0d>75%</color>　and　current　ATK　and　Accuracy　by　<color=#d14e0d>80%</color>,　up　to　3　consecutive　increases　for　1　turn.　Also　raise　Max　HP　by　<color=#d14e0d>280%　of　current</color>　HP,　at　most　<color=#d14e0d>3</color>　times　per　battle;　the　HP　bonus　persists.
At　5　Parry　stacks,　attacks　negate　invincibility　and　ignore　All　Damage　Reduction　for　1　turn.
At　8　Parry　stacks,　add　<color=#d14e0d>1</color>　post-action　use　of　<color=#d14e0d>Thunder　Bagua</color>　this　turn.
If　own　<color=#d14e0d>Block</color>　exceeds　target　<color=#d14e0d>Break　Rate</color>,　ignore　control　while　attacked.
In　the　first　two　turns,　if　own　<color=#d14e0d>Block</color>　exceeds　enemy　<color=#d14e0d>Break　Rate</color>,　one　hit　cannot　exceed　<color=#d14e0d>2%</color>　of　HP.
In　the　first　three　turns,　if　own　Block　exceeds　enemy　Break　Rate,　ignore　enemy　effects　and　clear　them　when　first　targeted.
From　turn　3,　if　own　Block　exceeds　enemy　Break　Rate,　ignore　elemental　damage　when　targeted.

When　a　skill　gives　an　enemy　<color=#d14e0d>Chill</color>,　give　all　allies　<color=#d14e0d>Ice　Armor</color>.
Each　<color=#d14e0d>Ice　Armor</color>　stack　raises　All　Damage　Reduction　by　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper1,57705}%</color>,　up　to　<color=#d14e0d>5</color>　stacks.　A　character　with　<color=#d14e0d>Ice　Armor</color>　gets　<color=#d14e0d>60%</color>　Speed,　without　stacking.　<color=#d14e0d>Yamato</color>　doubles　her　own　All　Damage　Reduction　gain　for　<color=#d14e0d>2</color>　turns.
Each　<color=#d14e0d>Ice　Armor</color>　stack　raises　<color=#d14e0d>Yamato's</color>　Block　Damage　Reduction　ratio　by　<color=#d14e0d>7%</color>.
When　attacked　with　<color=#d14e0d>Ice　Armor</color>,　ignore　both　sides'　Final　Damage　Bonus　and　Reduction　and　gain　immunity　to　Ice　damage.

At　battle　start,　there　is　a　<color=#d14e0d>{buffodds}%</color>　chance　to　gain　5　<color=#d14e0d>Ice　Armor</color>　stacks.　With　<color=#d14e0d>5</color>　<color=#d14e0d>Ice　Armor</color>　stacks,　on　lethal　damage　consume　all　<color=#d14e0d>Ice　Armor</color>　stacks　and　freeze　self.　Enemies　cannot　damage　Yamato,　and　she　is　immune　to　debuffs.\nAfter　allies　other　than　summons　act　<color=#d14e0d>4</color>　times　(Beasts　Pirates　count　as　2),　unfreeze,　restore　full　HP　and　refresh　action　state.　At　most　<color=#d14e0d>1</color>　time　per　battle.\nIf　no　other　ally　is　present,　the　next　attack　during　this　state　kills　Yamato.

All　attacks　add　Ice　damage　equal　to　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper1,57766}%</color>　of　ATK.　Raise　ATK,　Speed,　HP,　Accuracy,　Break　Rate,　Block　and　Crit　Damage　by　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper1,57768}%</color>,　and　All　Damage　Bonus　and　All　Damage　Reduction　by　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper1,57770}%</color>.　At　each　turn　start,　gain　<color=#d14e0d>5</color>　Soul　Jade;　reduce　Soul　Jade　cost　by　<color=#d14e0d>1</color>.
Permanently　increases　this　character's　<color=#d14e0d>Block　Rate　by　{attributevalper}%</color>.
Permanently　increases　this　character's　<color=#d14e0d>Block　Rate　by　{attributevalper}%</color>.
Permanently　increases　this　character's　<color=#d14e0d>Speed　by　{attributeper}%</color>.
Permanently　increases　this　character's　<color=#d14e0d>Speed　by　{attributeper}%</color>.
Permanently　increases　this　character's　<color=#d14e0d>ATK　by　{attributeper}%</color>.
Permanently　increases　this　character's　<color=#d14e0d>Max　HP　by　{attributeper}%</color>.
Permanently　increases　this　character's　<color=#d14e0d>Damage　Bonus　by　{attributevalper}%</color>.

Give　<color=#d14e0d>Wild　Blade　Strike</color>　a　<color=#d14e0d>{buffodds}%</color>　chance　to　<color=#d14e0d>Taunt</color>,　forcing　the　enemy　to　attack　Jack　for　<color=#d14e0d>2　turns</color>.　<color=#d14e0d>If　an　ally　stands　in　front　of　him,　Taunt　cannot　trigger</color>.　Also　a　<color=#d14e0d>{buffodds}%</color>　chance　to　<color=#d14e0d>resist　Knock-Up</color>　until　turn　end.

When　using　<color=#d14e0d>Sky　Split</color>,　immediately　heal　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper1,57903}%</color>　Max　HP　and　permanently　raise　<color=#d14e0d>healing　received</color>　by　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper1,57902}%</color>,　up　to　<color=#d14e0d>10　stacks</color>.
When　using　<color=#d14e0d>Mammoth　Impact</color>,　there　is　a　<color=#d14e0d>{buffodds}%</color>　chance　to　knock　the　target　into　the　air　<color=#d14e0d>1</color>　time　in　place.
After　<color=#d14e0d>Brutal　Execution</color>,　move　to　<color=#d14e0d>allied　rear</color>.　There　is　a　<color=#d14e0d>{buffodds}%</color>　chance　to　<color=#d14e0d>heal　to　current　Max　HP</color>.

When　using　<color=#d14e0d>Violent　Impact</color>,　raise　<color=#d14e0d>Damage　Bonus</color>　by　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper1,57911}%</color>　and　<color=#d14e0d>knock　enemy　units　back　2　tiles</color>,　starting　from　the　rear.

After　<color=#d14e0d>Mammoth　Assault</color>,　move　to　<color=#d14e0d>allied　front</color>　and　raise　<color=#d14e0d>Block　and　Tenacity</color>　by　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper1,57915}%</color>　for　<color=#d14e0d>3　turns</color>;　does　not　stack.

When　using　Wind　Blade　Break,　consume　1　Elephant　Skin　stack　and　enter　Guard,　with　Knock-Up　immunity,　for　2　turns.　With　this　skill　equipped,　trigger　it　free　1　time　at　battle　start.　Reapplying　Guard　immediately　ends　the　current　one.\nGuard:　while　active,　absorb　all　damage　taken　and　store　{buffper1,57982}%　of　it,　up　to　500%　of　panel　HP.　Exit　Guard　at　the　cap　and　release　stored　damage　immediately　whenever　Guard　or　Guard　ends.
When　<color=#d14e0d>Storm　Combo　Slash</color>　hits,　add　damage　equal　to　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper2,57906}%</color>　of　own　Max　HP.

After　<color=#d14e0d>Mammoth　Power</color>,　move　to　allied　front　and　raise　Block　by　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper1,57977}%</color>　for　3　turns;　does　not　stack.　Raise　<color=#d14e0d>Toughness　Break　efficiency</color>　of　allied　<color=#d14e0d>Beasts　Pirates</color>　and　<color=#d14e0d>Okuchi　Yamato</color>　by　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper1,57978}%</color>　for　up　to　<color=#d14e0d>2</color>　stacks　until　the　target's　next　action　ends.

On　healing,　<color=#d14e0d>record　overhealing</color>.　At　<color=#d14e0d>action　end</color>,　if　in　the　<color=#d14e0d>rear　2　rows</color>,　convert　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper1,57953}%</color>　of　it　to　<color=#d14e0d>shield</color>;　if　in　the　<color=#d14e0d>front　2　rows</color>,　convert　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper1,57954}%</color>　to　<color=#d14e0d>damage</color>　split　across　all　enemies,　capped　at　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper2,57954}%</color>　of　own　<color=#d14e0d>Max　HP</color>.

On　lethal　damage,　<color=#d14e0d>clear　enemy-applied　effects</color>,　retreat　to　allied　rear　and　<color=#d14e0d>heal　to　current　Max　HP</color>,　up　to　<color=#d14e0d>2　triggers</color>.\nRaise　all　allies'　Block　by　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper1,57971}%</color>　and　Hit　by　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper1,58004}%</color>;　raise　Jack's　Block　and　Hit　by　another　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper1,57972}%</color>.　Allied　<color=#d14e0d>Beasts　Pirates</color>　gain　Block　damage　reduction　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper1,57973}%</color>　and　clear　healing　prevention　at　turn　end.　<color=#d14e0d>Okuchi　Yamato</color>　gains　<color=#d14e0d>10%</color>　Block　damage　reduction　and　also　clears　healing　prevention　at　turn　end.

Raise　out-of-battle　panel　Max　HP　by　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper1,58010}%</color>.\nWhen　attacked　with　a　shield,　incoming　all-damage　bonus　cannot　exceed　<color=#d14e0d>100%</color>.\nAfter　being　hit,　there　is　a　<color=#d14e0d>{buffodds}%</color>　chance　to　gain　1　<color=#d14e0d>Elephant　Skin</color>　stack;　each　1　rearward　row　gives　1　extra　<color=#d14e0d>Elephant　Skin</color>.　Do　not　gain　more　while　<color=#d14e0d>Elephant　Skin　exists　and　fewer　than　3　allies　remain</color>,　excluding　banished　units.

After　battle　starts,　raise　Max　HP　by　{buffper1,57917}%,　DEF,　Block　and　Tenacity　by　{buffper2,57917}%,　Hit　by　100%　and　all　damage　reduction　by　{buffper3,57917}%;　gain　5　Soul　Jade　each　turn.　For　two　turns,　Jack's　Tenacity　and　Block　cannot　be　lowered;　when　targeted　by　a　skill,　gain　Tenacity　equal　to　60%　of　current　Block　during　that　skill.　At　battle　start,　give　allied　Beasts　Pirates　and　Okuchi　Yamato　Toughness　Break.\nIf　the　other　highest-ATK　ally　lacks　Toughness　Break,　give　it　Toughness　Break　at　only　40%　of　normal　strength.\nToughness　Break:　grants　ability　to　damage　Toughness　with　each　skill,　based　on　50%　of　base　panel　ATK　plus　skill　coefficient.

<color=#d14e0d>Immune　to　healing　prevention</color>.　At　turn　start,　heal　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper1,57944}%</color>　Max　HP.
In　the　rear　2　allied　rows,　absorb　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper1,57986}%</color>　of　damage　dealt　to　Dragon　Kaido　and　Okuchi　Yamato.
In　the　front　2　rows,　<color=#d14e0d>resist　removal</color>　and　always　hit.
Grant　allied　Kaido,　Dragon　Kaido　and　Okuchi　Yamato　<color=#d14e0d>10　Soul　Jade</color>　after　their　first　skill　each　turn.　At　battle　start,　<color=#d14e0d>always　hit</color>　for　<color=#d14e0d>1</color>　turn　and　<color=#d14e0d>be　invincible</color>　before　acting　in　turn　one.

Raise　<color=#d14e0d>Beasts　Pirates</color>　and　<color=#d14e0d>Okuchi　Yamato</color>　Speed　by　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper1,57970}%</color>　and　HP　and　Crit　Damage　by　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper2,57970}%</color>.　<color=#d14e0d>Lower　skill　Soul　Jade　cost　by　2</color>　without　losing　Rage　gain.　When　an　ally　<color=#d14e0d>uses　an　ultimate</color>,　each　<color=#d14e0d>1　remaining　Soul　Jade</color>　raises　<color=#d14e0d>Damage　Bonus</color>　by　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper1,57925}%</color>.\nAt　battle　start,　convert　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper3,57980}%</color>　of　own　Max　HP　into　ATK　for　those　allies,　capped　at　<color=#d14e0d>5　ten-thousands　(50,000)</color>,　once　per　battle.

PvP:　a　target　hit　by　Jack's　Knock-Up　that　lacks　Virtual　Toughness　has　a　{buffodds}%　chance　to　gain　Virtual　Toughness　equal　to　100%　of　its　pre-battle　HP　through　Virtual　Toughness.\nPvE:　damage　from　Beasts　Pirates　and　Okuchi　Yamato　has　a　{buffodds}%　chance　to　add　20%　of　damage　dealt　during　that　skill.\nVirtual　Toughness:　at　zero,　the　target　cannot　act　and　is　excluded　from　victory　checks　for　2　turns.　Virtual　Toughness　takes　Toughness　Break　damage　after　normal　Toughness　and　is　not　itself　normal　Toughness.

Each　time　Jack　switches　position,　raise　current　Max　HP　by　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper3,57998}%</color>　and　Hit　by　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper1,58002}%</color>,　up　to　4　times.　After　a　switch,　allied　<color=#d14e0d>Beasts　Pirates</color>　and　<color=#d14e0d>Okuchi　Yamato</color>　recover　<color=#d14e0d>50%</color>　Rage　after　ultimates,　up　to　<color=#d14e0d>2</color>　stacks.　If　they　have　at　least　<color=#d14e0d>5</color>　Soul　Jade　after　using　an　ultimate　and　can　use　it　again,　spend　<color=#d14e0d>5</color>　Soul　Jade　for　one　extra　use,　at　most　<color=#d14e0d>1</color>　trigger　per　action,　for　<color=#d14e0d>Beasts　Pirates</color>　and　<color=#d14e0d>Okuchi　Yamato</color>.
Permanently　increases　this　character's　<color=#d14e0d>Max　HP　by　{attributeper}%</color>.
Permanently　increases　this　character's　<color=#d14e0d>Tenacity　by　{attributevalper}%</color>.
Permanently　increases　this　character's　<color=#d14e0d>DEF　by　{attributeper}%</color>.
Permanently　increases　this　character's　<color=#d14e0d>Block　Rate　by　{attributevalper}%</color>.
Permanently　increases　this　character's　<color=#d14e0d>ATK　by　{attributeper}%</color>.
Permanently　increases　this　character's　<color=#d14e0d>Max　HP　by　{attributeper}%</color>.
Permanently　increases　this　character's　<color=#d14e0d>Damage　Reduction　by　{attributevalper}%</color>.

When　using　<color=#d14e0d>This　Is　My　Prey</color>　with　at　least　<color=#d14e0d>3</color>　<color=#d14e0d>Magnetism</color>　stacks,　there　is　a　<color=#d14e0d>{buffodds}%</color>　chance　for　Kid　to　crit　for　this　action　and　convert　Accuracy　into　<color=#d14e0d>2</color>　times　as　much　Crit　Damage　Bonus.　Otherwise,　there　is　a　<color=#d14e0d>{buffodds}%</color>　chance　to　raise　Crit　Rate　by　<color=#d14e0d>60%</color>　and　convert　Accuracy　into　<color=#d14e0d>1</color>　times　as　much　Crit　Damage　Bonus　until　this　action　ends.

When　using　<color=#d14e0d>Magnet:　String</color>　with　at　least　<color=#d14e0d>3</color>　<color=#d14e0d>Magnetism</color>　stacks,　the　attack　disables　the　target's　skill-damage　limit　until　Kid's　action　ends.　The　fastest　enemy　is　then　pulled　toward　the　slowest　enemy;　the　fastest　enemy's　Speed　falls　by　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper1,58066}%</color>　for　<color=#d14e0d>2</color>　turns,　without　stacking.　<color=#d14e0d>(This　Slow　counts　as　an　effect　applied　by　the　slowest　ally.)</color>

When　<color=#d14e0d>Gamma　Knife</color>　hits　a　target　with　<color=#d14e0d>3</color>　<color=#d14e0d>Anesthesia</color>　stacks,　it　is　guaranteed　to　crit.　On　a　skill　crit,　there　is　a　<color=#d14e0d>{buffodds}%</color>　chance　to　deal　extra　Toughness　damage　equal　to　<color=#d14e0d>10%</color>　of　own　initial　ATK;　Toughness　Break　Efficiency　does　not　affect　it.

When　<color=#d14e0d>Shock　Wave</color>　hits　a　target　with　<color=#d14e0d>Anesthesia</color>,　other　allies'　Speed　rises　by　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper1,58069}%</color>　and　own　Speed　by　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper1,58070}%</color>,　stacking　up　to　<color=#d14e0d>5</color>　times　for　<color=#d14e0d>2</color>　turns.

After　using　<color=#d14e0d>Temporary　Alliance</color>,　switch　the　active　character　and　reset　skill　cooldowns.　There　is　a　<color=#d14e0d>{buffodds}%</color>　chance　to　gain　<color=#d14e0d>1</color>　<color=#d14e0d>Magnetism</color>　stack　and　a　<color=#d14e0d>{buffodds}%</color>　chance　to　give　every　enemy　<color=#d14e0d>1</color>　<color=#d14e0d>Anesthesia</color>　stack.

When　using　<color=#d14e0d>Electromagnetic　Cannon</color>,　each　<color=#d14e0d>Magnetism</color>　stack　raises　Final　Damage　Bonus　by　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper1,58073}%</color>,　counting　up　to　<color=#d14e0d>3</color>　stacks.　At　<color=#d14e0d>3</color>　<color=#d14e0d>Magnetism</color>　stacks,　attacks　disable　the　target's　Invincibility.

After　using　<color=#d14e0d>Puncture　Shock</color>,　hit　targets　cannot　raise　their　<color=#d14e0d>Speed</color>　before　acting　in　the　<color=#d14e0d>next　turn</color>.　When　a　target　has　<color=#d14e0d>3</color>　<color=#d14e0d>Anesthesia</color>　stacks,　there　is　a　<color=#d14e0d>{buffodds}%</color>　chance　to　deal　<color=#d14e0d>1</color>　extra　Toughness　hit　equal　to　<color=#d14e0d>50%</color>　of　own　initial　ATK;　Toughness　Break　Efficiency　does　not　affect　it.

At　the　start　of　the　first　turn,　give　Kid　&　Law　and　the　other　ally　with　the　highest　ATK　Toughness　Break　(same　effects　from　teammates　do　not　stack).　That　ally　with　Toughness　Break　takes　at　most　{buffper1,58165}%　Crit　Damage　for　4　turns.　At　battle　start,　gain　Toughness　equal　to　{buffper3,58121}%　of　pre-battle　Max　HP.\nWhile　Kid　&　Law　has　Toughness,　HP　cannot　fall　below　50%.\nToughness　Break:　A　unit　with　Toughness　Break　can　damage　Toughness.　Each　skill　deals　Toughness　damage　based　on　{buffper3,58076}%　of　base　ATK　and　its　skill　coefficient.

Switching　characters　forcibly　resets　current　action　status　(1　time　per　turn)　and　restores　<color=#d14e0d>5　Soul　Jade</color>.\nWhen　hit　and　own　Toughness　falls　to　<color=#d14e0d>0</color>,　immediately　switch　and　restore　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper1,58086}%</color>　Toughness　and　<color=#d14e0d>{buffper1,58087}%</color>　HP;　triggers　only　<color=#d14e0d>1</color>　time　per　battle.\nOn　the　first　action,　remove　all　own　debuffs.

While　Kid　is　active:　Law's　assist　attacks　apply　Anesthesia　(up　to　3　stacks)　and　permanently　grant　Kid　Magnetic　Levitation　(up　to　3　stacks).　If　a　Law　assist　hits　a　target　with　3　Anesthesia　stacks,　immediately　cut　away　{buffper1,58110}%　of　its　HP　(up　to　10　times　own　ATK)　and　apply　1　Anesthesia　stack　to　other　enemies　in　the　nine-cell　area.\nWhile　Law　is　active:　Toughness　Break　Efficiency　rises　by　30%.　After　each　Law　skill,　Kid　assists　and　gains　Magnetism　(up　to　5　stacks).　All　enemies　with　Anesthesia　take　10%　of　own　initial　ATK　as　Toughness　damage,　unaffected　by　Break　Efficiency.　Targets　with　3　Anesthesia　stacks　take　1　extra　hit　of　20%　initial-ATK　Toughness　damage,　also　unaffected.\nMagnetic　Levitation:　At　each　turn　start,　each　Magnetic　Levitation　stack　raises　Kid　&　Law's　Speed　by　{buffper3,58111}%　of　its　current　value　for　that　turn.　Each　Magnetic　Levitation　stack　also　raises　Kid　&　Law's　current　ATK　by　{buffper3,58112}%　and　All　Damage　Bonus　by　{buffper1,58113}%　persistently,　up　to　6　stacks.

This　talent　chooses　the　starting　fighter:　off　is　<color=#9933ff>Kid</color>,　on　is　<color=#0606c1>Law</color>.　Each　character　carries　all　of　their　own　skills　when　entering　or　switching.
